我叫基雅·祖蒙，这就是我开出的条件！

她从坐席上起身，随从徐徐跪服在她的身侧。

我将率领你的军队，击溃你的敌人。他们的星球将化为焦土，他们的财宝将为你所得。

我叫基雅·祖蒙，这就是我开出的条件！

她从坐席上起身，随从徐徐跪服在她的身侧。

我将率领你的军队，击溃你的敌人。他们的星球将化为焦土，他们的财宝将为你所得。
texts.en:
A litter of enormous proportions is carried by a procession of slaves. Atop it sits a formidable reptilian. All the hallmarks of a warlord are there: extensive scarring, brazen weaponry, the skeletal remnants of past kills.

I am Gia'Zumon, and these are my terms!

As she removes herself from the throne, the members of her entourage prostrate themselves before her.

I will lead your armies. I will break your enemies. Their worlds shall burn and their riches will be yours.

label.zh: 等会儿。你怎么会想加入我们？
label.en: Hold on. Why do you want to join us?
